Antwerp bureau: Richemont, owner of Cartier and Van Cleef & Arpels, says European jewellery demand grew too — the Jewellery Maisons rose 19% worldwide, Europe 13%, both at constant rates.

Antwerpen: Richemont (Cartier, Van Cleef & Arpels) meldt 13% meer juweelomzet in Europa dit halfjaar, tegen 19% wereldwijd. Groepsomzet €12,3 miljard, +17%.

Full story on caratcapital.org, link in bio.

Source: Richemont press release, 13 Nov 2026.
